{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
df['revenue_numeric'] = pd.to_numeric(df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Identify internal test orders: those with revenue '999,999.99'
mask_test = df['revenue'] == '999,999.99'

# Identify completed orders
mask_completed = df['status'] == 'completed'

# Define the population: completed orders that are not internal test orders
population = df[mask_completed & ~mask_test]

# Calculate total revenue
total_revenue = population['revenue_numeric'].sum()

# Print the result
total_revenue"}
